blocks.text: Yeh bacterial cell ki plasma membrane ke gird ek sakht (rigid) deewar hai. Bacterial cell wall ka sab se bara hissa ek khaas macromolecule (bohat bara molecule) hai jise peptidoglycan ya murein kehte hain. Yeh lambi glycan (polysaccharide) chain se bana hai jo chhote peptide tukron se cross-link (aapas mein jura hua) hoti hai (Figure 2.2). Is ki miqdar mukhtalif bacteria mein alag alag hoti hai. Cell wall mein lipids bhi hote hain jo peptidoglycan se jure hote hain.

blocks.alt: Peptidoglycan ka gend (ball) model: bari gulabi aur narangi gendon ki teen zanjeerein (glycan) saath saath chalti hain. Har doosri glycan unit se chaar chhoti rangeen gendon (amino acids) ki khari qatar neeche chhote jamuni motiyon ki lari tak jati hai, aur yun tehain aapas mein jur kar jaal (mesh) banati hain. Labels: Glycan, Amino acids.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.2: Peptidoglycan ka molecular model (kitab ki Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Gram’s staining
blocks.text: Sir Hans Christian Gram ne Gram’s staining ki technique banayi. Gram-positive bacteria purple (jamni) rang lete hain kyunke woh violet dye ko apne andar rok lete hain. Gram-negative bacteria violet dye nahin rokte, is liye woh apne asal rang mein nazar aate hain. (Lab mein aakhir mein aam tor par safranin jaisa doosra rang (counterstain) lagaya jata hai, is liye Gram-negative bacteria pink dikhte hain.)

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bari gulabi aur narangi gendein sugar units hain jo mil kar lambi glycan (polysaccharide) zanjeer banati hain. Chhoti rangeen gendon ki khari qataarein amino acids ke chhote peptide tukre hain jo zanjeeron ko aapas mein jorte (cross-link karte) hain. Isi jaal ki wajah se cell wall mazboot rehti hai aur bacterium ki shakal qaim rehti hai.

Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria mein cell wall ki composition (kis cheez se bani hai) kaafi mukhtalif hai. Gram-positive bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan ki moti teh (layer) hoti hai aur lipid kam hota hai. Jabke Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan ki patli teh hoti hai.

Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall mein ek outer membrane (bahar wali jhilli) hoti hai jo lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins se bani hai. Yeh outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko bohat si antibiotics ke khilaf resistant (asar na hone dene wala) banati hai. Is mein porin naam ka protein hota hai jo khaas molecules ke liye pore (soorakh) ka kaam karta hai. Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall mein periplasmic space (peptidoglycan layer aur cell membrane ke darmiyan ki jagah) Gram-positive se zyada hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do walls ke hisse saath saath. Gram-Positive: motiyon ki chaar tehon wala mota peptidoglycan, periplasmic space, aur cell membrane jis mein ek protein hai. Gram-Negative: outer membrane jis par lipopolysaccharide hai aur jis ke aar paar ek porin hai, lipoprotein jo use patli peptidoglycan teh se jorta hai, periplasmic space, aur cell membrane jis mein ek protein hai. Labels: Peptidoglycan, Periplasmic space, Cell membrane, Protein, Outer membrane, Lipopolysaccharide, Porin, Lipoprotein.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall ki tarkeeb (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen (left) taraf Gram-positive wall mein peptidoglycan ki moti teh hai, is liye yeh violet dye rok leti hai. Daen (right) taraf Gram-negative wall mein peptidoglycan patla hai aur us ke upar ek outer membrane hai (lipopolysaccharide aur lipoprotein wali). Peela porin is membrane mein darwaze (pore) ka kaam karta hai. Dono mein periplasmic space peptidoglycan aur cell membrane ke darmiyan ki jagah hai.

blocks.text: Kuch bacteria apni cell wall ke bahar capsule banate hain. Yeh gelatinous (jelly jaisi) teh hai jo bacterial colonies ko chipchipa (sticky) bana deti hai.
